info.description: Open-weight mixture-of-experts reasoning model for German and English, released on 3 October 2026 under Apache 2.0. The model card lists a context length of 1,048,576 tokens and recommends at most 262,144 tokens for serving efficiency. reasoning_effort accepts none, low, medium, or high, and the card documents tool calling and structured output. No standard API token price or first-party request URL is published.

zh.description: 面向德语和英语的开放权重混合专家推理模型，2026 年 10 月 3 日以 Apache 2.0 发布。模型卡列出的上下文长度为 1,048,576 tokens，并建议为了服务效率最多使用 262,144 tokens。reasoning_effort 可取 none、low、medium 或 high，模型卡写明支持工具调用和结构化输出。没有公布 API 标准 token 价格或第一方请求 URL。
